name: RBI Desk
description: Official RBI rates, weekly foreign exchange reserves, notices and searchable Master Directions, with source dates and receipts.
author: Vakyartha

web__fetch_page.reason: Read official rates, releases, reserves and notices from the source destinations you approve.

tools.name: get_rbi_rates
tools.description: RBI's current policy repo, SDF, MSF and bank rates, CRR and SLR, FBIL reference exchange rates, lending and deposit rate ranges, call and T-bill rates, each exactly as published with its as-on date, plus the last change RBI Desk saw

rate.description: Return only this rate, such as repo, crr, slr or usd. Omit for the full panel.

tools.name: get_rbi_briefing
tools.description: A spoken RBI briefing: current policy rates, ratios, the dollar reference rate, any changes seen and the latest RBI releases, as sentences to read aloud

tools.name: get_rate_history
tools.description: Stored daily values and change points of one RBI rate (repo, sdf, msf, bank, crr, slr or usd) since RBI Desk began reading

rate.description: One of repo, sdf, msf, bank, crr, slr, usd

tools.name: get_rbi_updates
tools.description: Official RBI press releases, notifications (circulars), bulletin, annual report and tenders, newest first, with links

feed.description: Optional: Press releases, Notifications, Bulletin, Annual report or Tenders; omitted means all except Tenders

tag.description: Optional topic: policy, penalty, gold-bond, auction, deposit-rates, kyc, payments, forex-reserves

query.description: Optional words that must all appear in the title or excerpt

tools.name: get_forex_reserves
tools.description: Official RBI total foreign exchange reserves and FCA, gold, SDR and IMF components in US$ million and INR crore, with week-ending date and published weekly changes.

tools.name: find_master_direction
tools.description: Search the official RBI Master Directions directory by topic, including KYC or payments. Returns exact titles, official links, categories, issue and amendment dates; not legal interpretation.

feeds.description: Official RBI feed items, newest first

skills.name: rbi
skills.description: Read RBI Desk rates, reserves, Master Directions and notices with source dates
